## Wrestlers by Weight Class

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(tidyverse)
library(htmltools)

# Read athlete data and sort by weight class and points
athletes <- read_csv("data/athletes.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  arrange(weight_class, desc(points_scored), name)

# Get unique weight classes for the dropdown options
weight_classes <- sort(unique(athletes$weight_class))

options_html <- paste(
  sprintf('<option value="%s">%s lbs</option>', weight_classes, weight_classes),
  collapse = ""
)

rows_html <- paste(
  sprintf('<tr data-wc="%s"><td>%s</td><td>%s</td><td>%s lbs</td><td>%s</td></tr>',
          athletes$weight_class, athletes$name, athletes$team, athletes$weight_class, athletes$points_scored),
  collapse = ""
)

HTML(paste0(
  '<div style="margin: 1.5rem 0;">',
  '<label for="weightClassSelect" style="font-weight: bold; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; display: block;">Select a Weight Class:</label>',
  '<select id="weightClassSelect" class="form-select" style="max-width: 260px; font-size: 1rem; padding: 0.4rem;" onchange="filterWrestlers(this.value)">',
  '<option value="all">All Weight Classes</option>',
  options_html,
  '</select>',
  '<div id="wrestlerCount" style="margin-top: 0.5rem; font-style: italic; color: #555;">Showing all ', nrow(athletes), ' wrestlers</div>',
  '</div>',
  '<table id="wrestlerTable" class="table table-striped table-hover" style="width: 100%; margin-top: 1rem;">',
  '<thead><tr><th>Wrestler</th><th>Team</th><th>Weight Class</th><th>Points Scored</th></tr></thead>',
  '<tbody>', rows_html, '</tbody>',
  '</table>',
  '<script>',
  'function filterWrestlers(selectedWeight) {',
  '  const rows = document.querySelectorAll("#wrestlerTable tbody tr");',
  '  let count = 0;',
  '  rows.forEach(row => {',
  '    if (selectedWeight === "all" || row.getAttribute("data-wc") === selectedWeight) {',
  '      row.style.display = "";',
  '      count++;',
  '    } else {',
  '      row.style.display = "none";',
  '    }',
  '  });',
  '  const countEl = document.getElementById("wrestlerCount");',
  '  if (countEl) {',
  '    countEl.textContent = (selectedWeight === "all") ?',
  '      ("Showing all " + count + " wrestlers") :',
  '      ("Showing " + count + " wrestlers in " + selectedWeight + " lbs");',
  '  }',
  '}',
  '</script>'
))
```
